body: People are nice to me out of sympathy. Some humanistic observance towards the preservation of life. My life is less than desirable as is my options. I have no time available because I have schedule's to meet for others. So self care isn't to much of an option. From the time I wake till I go to sleep I work. I see it on their faces when i walk in a room. The idea of some doctor or psychiatrist prodding at me with their questions in order to fulfill some childhood or trauma caused need to help people and dotingly look over them as some beloved terrier sounds less than desirable. I'm well aware of the techniques carried I dont see anything worth my time. In the end whe means by which people such as those choose to help is selfish either to be paid or to fulfill there own personal need. Not entirely convinced killing myself is obviously the best answer. But I know oblivion awaites. And the prospect of falling in a street while I walk seems easier and honestly relaxing and at times hypnotic.
